problem_type: Media result type erased at storyboard preview boundary
symptom: gate-r2 persisted success videos display image load failure in storyboard rows.
direct_cause: All eight gate-r2 results have type video and nomi-local MP4 URLs without thumbnailUrl; resultDisplayUrl falls back to the MP4 and StoryboardShotFrame passes it to NomiImage.
class_root: Storyboard preview rendering loses the result media type when selecting a decoder.
affected_population: Video results without thumbnails, from any provider or persisted project
Existing video results retained while generating or failed
internal_only_reason: Internal result type projection and existing media component selection; no external API or dependency behavior changes.
invariants: Only image results or explicit image thumbnails may enter NomiImage.
Video results without thumbnails use the existing managed video decoder and its load-error/retry lifecycle.
generality_proof: One renderer within StoryboardShotFrame serves final and retained results, branching on persisted result type, independent of URL extension, protocol, provider, or shot kind.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Choose the decoder for all storyboard result preview states.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Final result branches call the shared renderResult function.
Retained results use the same renderResult function as final results.
HistoryVideoPreview already routes video URLs to DeferredNodeVideo and only explicit thumbnails to images.
ShotVariant currently has only url; rg variantsByShotId= src returns no production wiring. Only design-lab supplies SVG variants, so no video producer reaches this unfinished feature.

recurrence.reason: Every video result lacking an optional thumbnail triggers the same deterministic decoder mismatch.
same_class_scan: rg resultUrl / NomiImage in StoryboardShotFrame finds done, generating and failed branches.
Read NodeResultStack HistoryVideoPreview and DeferredNodeMedia: managed video lifecycle already exists.
Read storyboardRowStatus resultDisplayUrl: URL-only projection selects thumbnail or raw result.

prevention.invariant: All storyboard preview states select their decoder using result type and explicit thumbnail availability.
prevention.failure_mode: Genuine video decode failures remain visible through DeferredNodeVideo and only its free media reload is offered.
prevention.strategy: Replace all three image-only render sites with one shared result renderer using existing components.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removes three unconditional image-decoder sites; no parallel fallback remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application media dispatch bug; existing React/video lifecycle is reused without changing dependencies.

migration: No persisted format changes; old video results retain their declared type and now select the correct decoder.
residual_risks: Video variant drawer integration is not connected today; a future producer must preserve media type rather than supplying MP4 to image-only ShotVariant.url.
Electron test uses the real full storyboard row host and local protocol decoding with fixed props; it does not claim a new end-to-end paid generation run.
Existing storyboard frame index/duration chips remain low-contrast in dark theme; C75 explicitly covers canvas shot-label and mount badges, so these separate frame chips are outside this change.
